verdicts.observation: The four ordered frames keep the east-facing carrier, held load, palette and head scale coherent; leg separation supplies the carry walk.
Between frames 0 and 1 the head and shoulders jump upward substantially while the grounded lower silhouette barely moves; the drinking figure visibly stretches on the loop.
Frame 1 becomes markedly taller and longer through the torso than frame 0 with the feet remaining grounded; the eat loop changes body proportions.
East-facing hand gestures retain consistent standing height, hair, clothing and body placement across both frames.
Raised and lowered tool poses read as a build stroke; head height, workpiece placement and character palette remain coherent.
Both frames maintain a low front-facing crouch with matching head height and grounded legs; arm movement is plausible.
The second frame raises the entire head and lengthens the upper body noticeably while the lower body remains fixed; repeated drinking produces a strong height pop.
Both front-facing eating frames keep the same standing height, hair mass and clothing while hands move around the food at the mouth.
The forward gathering pose transitions to a more upright hand-to-body pose; the modest head rise follows the lean and the character identity remains coherent.
Frame 1 abruptly widens the shoulders and torso and changes the narrow oblique idle into a broad frontal silhouette; the loop reshapes the body instead of a small idle motion.
The single supplied frame reads as a compact front-facing seated pose with bent legs and matching hair and clothing; there is no multi-frame cycle to compare.
One-hand and two-hand gestures preserve front view, head scale and grounded standing height with only a small plausible bob.
The four frames alternate leg and arm placement with a small walk bob; overall height, palette and character proportions remain consistent.
